title: WaterColor "Big View II" 431 East Royal Fern Way
h1: WaterColor "Big View II" 431 East Royal Fern Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 10 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Crossings II community of WaterColor- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- 5 adult bikes provided- Private pool - Fireplace- Lanai with grill- Home office- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Enchanting days are ahead at Big View II, a WaterColor home with 5 bedrooms and 5.5 bathrooms that comfortably sleeps 10. Take advantage of access to WaterColor’s Beach Club, Boathouse, walking trails, and stunning views of the Gulf of Mexico—all a short walk or bike ride away. Guests are sure to adore this property’s sunny lanai and private pool in the secluded backyard.Worries slip away between the shiplap walls of this 2-story home. Step inside to find coffered ceilings and gleaming wood floors in the first-floor great room. With plenty of space for family and friends, guests will love spending time lounging on the comfortable sofas and armchairs in the living area as the fireplace warms cool nights and the conversation flows. Gather in the kitchen, where Wolf appliances make cooking a euphoric experience, and share a chilled bottle from the wine cooler as the group chef works culinary magic. The 6-person dining table is nestled inside a windowed alcove. Through the sliding glass doors is the airy lanai, seamlessly merging indoor and outdoor living with a built-in grill, soft seating, TV, and 2-person café table—the ultimate spot to while away a blissful day. Steps out the back door, discover the crystalline pool with 4 nearby loungers and a remote setting that abuts the thriving greenspace behind the home. Retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom.Go up the sunlit stairwell to the top floor, where a second living space with a couch and TV awaits. Attached is a covered balcony with a padded porch swing. There are 3 guest bedrooms—2 with a king bed and 1 with 2 twin beds—and a primary bedroom with a king bed on this floor. All the bedrooms have private bathrooms.Enjoy an unforgettable WaterColor stay at Big View II. Easily explore the area with 5 complimentary adult bikes. Guests have access to the private beach club in main WaterColor and the public Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara beach accesses. Book this lovely beach home today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.*Unfortunately, the pool cannot be heated.
